facts.text: Rice from the Bedouin traders on the road to Beersheba
facts.why: Wikipedia's plot and the NFSA notes show no Bedouin traders or rice, only the march and charge at Beersheba.
facts.fix: Rice and dates, a pilaf for the camp at Beersheba

facts.text: Dave Mitchell's Beersheba lamb and date pilaf
facts.why: Wikipedia's cast list gives Peter Phelps as Dave Mitchell, the new trooper who replaces Frank.
facts.fix: Dave's Beersheba lamb and date pilaf

facts.text: Taken before the charge on the wells.
facts.why: No source shows a rum ration taken before the charge; the plot only has the Light Horse lining up and charging Beersheba's wells.
facts.fix: A tin mug for the long ride to the wells at Beersheba.

vibe.verdict: The charge, the Turks firing high, Dave and the wells all print on a solid Beersheba camp card, though the food is standard camp tucker.
